text:
No option can be put forward from this run, because the £400k annual-salary limit was not checkable and was excluded from the comparison.

- The comparison is fragile and rests substantially on Olumi-supplied estimates; delivery capacity, onboarding load and annual salary spend are the key assumptions.
- The stated salary constraint is recorded but its frame is unknown, and the model cannot align it with the calculated salary-spend measure. It also lacks an attested direction for the Q3 goal.
- The results therefore describe relative model behaviour only, not whether any hiring plan meets your budget or ships by Q3.
